name: White Book Complete Volume
source:
"There exists a white book that can alter its reader's perception of reality. Through fiction, their future is foretold. No one should ever have this kind of privilege. 
Should you ever stumble upon it resist the urge to read its contents. Alas, the book will always find its reader and will continue to exist as long as there are stories to be told. "
translation:
“有一本白皮书可以改变读者对现实的看法。通过小说，他们的未来被预言。任何人都不应该拥有这种特权。
如果你偶然发现它，请抵制阅读其内容的冲动。唉，只要还有故事可讲，这本书就总会找到它的读者，并且就会继续存在。”
